reason: I'd sign up for the free plan and poke at it some evening, but I'm not paying 99 € a month on top of ChatGPT until I see it actually answer my customer emails and post for me without me redoing everything. A LinkedIn ad full of 'AI co-workers' isn't proof it gives me hours back.
objection: I already pay for ChatGPT. I can't tell what this does that I can't already do with that, and I don't know how far 100 credits gets me before I'm paying more.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it handle a week of my real customer emails and social posts on the free plan, with the time it saved shown to me, plus a plain answer on what one credit buys.
